thread.title: These Stocks Gained the Most in a $2.1 Billion Day for This ETF

author: thestreet.com
title: These Stocks Gained the Most in a $2.1 Billion Day for This ETF
text:
Stocks may have ended in the red on Tuesday, Feb. 27, but inflows into the SPDR S&P 500 ( SPY )  exchange-trade fund fund were still big-time.
Investors added $2.11 billion to the SPDR S&P 500 ETF in Tuesday's trading session, increasing the fund's assets by 0.8% to $278.5 billion, according to data from Bloomberg. The fund has reached net inflows of $7.25 billion in the past year.
At the end of trading Tuesday, the fund's biggest holdings were, unsurprisingly, some of Wall Street's darlings.
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) saw an increase of 1.09 million shares in the fund Tuesday, pushing its position to 60.4 million shares total worth about $10.8 billion. Apple stock represents 3.9% of the fund as a whole. Apple stock closed Tuesday down 0.32% to $178.39. Shares gained 0.83% in early trading Wednesday.
Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ) comes in second as far as holdings with 3.1% of the fund. In Tuesday trading, investors added 1.63 million shares to reach 90.7 million in the fund, tallying a grand total worth $8.54 billion. Microsoft stock finished Tuesday lower 1.28% to $94.20. Shares gained 1.18% in early trading Wednesday.
Next came Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) , which represents 2.6% of the fund's total asset value. On Tuesday, Amazon's share of the fund increased by 84,708 shares to 4.7 million. The Amazon holdings in the fund are worth $7.11 billion. Amazon stock fell 0.66% to $1,511.98 at the market close Tuesday. On Wednesday morning, shares were up 0.96%.
Facebook Inc. ( FB ) shares were 1.8% of the total asset value of the ETF. Investors added 504,266 to tally 28 million shares total in the fund, worth $5.09 billion. Facebook stock dipped 1.88% to $181.46 Tuesday. Shares gained 0.67% in morning action Wednesday.
JPMorgan Chase & Co. ( JPM )  was 1.7% of the fund, with total value tallying $4.79 billion. In Tuesday trading, investors added 733,774 JPM shares to reach 40.8 million total. JPMorgan stock lost 1.19% Tuesday to close at $117.36. On Wednesday, JPM stock gained 0.85%.
The fund itself fell 1.27% Tuesday to $274.38. On Wednesday, shares of the fund gained 0.60% in morning trading.
Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Facebook and JPMorgan are holdings in Jim Cramer's Action Alerts PLUS Charitable Trust Portfolio . Want to be alerted before Cramer buys or sells the stocks? Learn more now.
